source_folder: real marwari horse images/ (originals unedited, git-ignored)
rights: Owner confirmed in chat on 14 Nov 2026 that they have permission to publish the unwatermarked photos. Photos carrying a third-party watermark or signature are excluded and nothing was removed from any photo.
identity: Galleries are grouped by individual horse only where photos come from one session with matching markings, tack and setting. No names, breed claims, pedigree or ownership are attached; none is an academy fleet record.

galleries.title: Horse Study 01
galleries.note: One black horse with a broad white blaze and pink muzzle, photographed in a single studio session.

images.caption: Head and neck turned toward the lens; the blaze runs from forelock to muzzle.
images.alt: A black horse with a broad white blaze and inward-curving ears against a mottled green backdrop, head turned toward the camera.
images.edits: Re-encoded to WebP (q82), metadata stripped; no crop or retouching.

images.caption: Square to the camera, ears pricked and curled inward.
images.alt: A black horse facing the camera head-on against a green backdrop, ears curving inward until the tips nearly meet.
